data.one_liner: Flutter plugin for Huawei Push Kit, enabling push and local notifications on Android.
data.what_it_does: Provides a Dart interface to Huawei Push Kit SDK, allowing apps to receive push messages, schedule local notifications, and handle deep links. It also supports exact alarm scheduling for Android 12+.
use_when: Need push notifications on Huawei devices
Want to use Huawei's native push service instead of Firebase
Require local notification scheduling with exact timing
avoid_when: Targeting only iOS or non-Huawei Android devices
strengths: Full coverage of Huawei Push Kit SDK features
Supports scheduled local notifications and deep linking
weaknesses: Requires Huawei account and AppGallery Connect setup
data.setup_notes: Add dependency to pubspec, add android permission <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.SCHEDULE_EXACT_ALARM"/> in AndroidManifest, configure AppGallery Connect credentials, initialize plugin in main.dart.

alternatives.name: firebase_messaging
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides cross‑platform push notifications and works on non‑Huawei devices
